The Loft is a new and exclusive apartment from 2024, located right in the heart of Tromsø. With 130 m² of space, it offers plenty of room, designer furniture, luxurious Jensen beds, 2.5 bathrooms, two showers, and a jacuzzi. Enjoy your morning coffee on the balcony overlooking the sea, or relax on the rooftop terrace with views of the mountains and ocean. The apartment is one of the finest in central Tromsø, combining luxury and comfort.

Public paid parking is available outside the building.

The space
"The Loft" features spacious and bright rooms with a modern Scandinavian design.

There is no elevator in the building, so you must be able to climb stairs to reach the apartment.

The apartment has four bedrooms with exclusive Jensen beds, two bathrooms with showers—one of which also features a bathtub—and an additional guest toilet.

The kitchen is fully equipped and open to the dining area. The living room has large windows and access to a private balcony with views of the mountains and sea. In the backyard, you will find a rooftop terrace. The entire apartment is finished to a high standard and was newly built in 2024.

We have put a lot of time, care, and attention into creating this apartment, and we hope you will feel right at home during your stay.

Guest access
You will have full and private access to the entire apartment throughout your stay. No part of the apartment is shared with anyone else.

Other things to note
Important information:

You must be at least 30 years old to book this accommodation.

Bachelor/bachelorette parties or other events are not permitted at the property.

Quiet hours begin at 10:00 PM.

Smoking is not permitted inside the apartment.

Please do not wear ice cleats/spikes indoors.
